summary.headline: Christianbook secures $1.24M in fully-finalized annual savings across five key spend areas
summary.narrative: Treya Partners partnered with Christianbook to run competitive sourcing events for merchant processing, packaging, corrugated, and freight. All five targeted categories are now under new or renegotiated contracts, delivering $1,237,359 in recurring annual savings—an average 13-14% reduction on $9.2 million of addressable spend. Signature wins include 31% savings on LTL freight through a new carrier and a 10% reduction in merchant processing fees by transitioning to Calibr, all without operational disruption.
